prospective.primary_h1: Within the same qualified T47D model, compare WT/E112Q/Y74E rescue patterns across hormone and purine-stress contexts; use endpoint-specific scales/models, not raw pooling. If only different cell models are feasible, narrow the inference accordingly.
minimum_core_h1: NUDT5-depleted cells rescued with empty/WT/E112Q/Y74E near endogenous expression
Hormone-starved and stimulated conditions using Page protocol as a starting point
Predeclared nuclear ATP time-course summary; orthogonal downstream transcription and direct counts as secondary outcomes
TH5427 and MRK-952 at independently qualified engagement windows with protein abundance monitored
Purine-stress arm only after a measurable same-line response is established; HAP1 serves known positive-control replication
conditional_arms: Compound 9 plus NUDT14 loss/WT-rescue, NUDT5/14 double perturbation and counterscreened BTK control only if a differential effect/window exists

dNUDT5 paired with dNUDT5nc if available; both can engage NUDT5, but the control lacks productive degradation. Recheck abundance/time course and selectivity in the intended cells; neither is assumed biologically inert

gates.go: Structures, stereochemical uncertainty, physical sample identity, purity/solubility and protein species/construct are documented for intended use.
gates.no_go: Unresolved identity, uncertain usable exposure or missing construct precludes the affected strict claim.
gates.not_falsification: Supply or metadata failure is not a test of H1/H2 biology.
gates.numerical_rule: No invented cutoff; establish analytical acceptance and exposure-specific suitability independently.

gates.go: Direct product assays have a characterized linear range and reproducibility; orthogonal binding is interpretable; aggregation/reporter controls pass; ATP-producing reaction is separately measured.
gates.no_go: Signal interference, unqualified detection, absent functional baseline or inconsistent orthogonal results.
gates.not_falsification: An invalid assay cannot refute the biological hypothesis.
gates.numerical_rule: Dynamic range and precision derived from independent assay qualification; no generic fold-change or potency requirement imposed.

gates.go: Near-endogenous WT/E112Q/Y74E have appropriate fold/dimer/localization and intended hydrolysis/ATP-production/PPAT-binding properties.
gates.no_go: Catalysis and PPAT binding cannot be separated without confounding abundance or localization.
gates.not_falsification: A failed allele is not evidence that catalysis is dispensable or required.
gates.numerical_rule: Predefine equivalence/functional margins from independent assay capability and mechanistic relevance.

gates.go: Validated NUDT5 engagement with abundance measured; NUDT14 and BTK contribution assessable; reporter/general toxicity and hormone/purine assay competence established.
gates.no_go: No exposure window separates the proposed mechanisms or no baseline phenotype is measurable.
gates.not_falsification: Equal dose is not equal engagement; thermal shifts are not calibrated occupancy.
gates.numerical_rule: Choose concentrations from measured engagement/exposure and assay qualification rather than literature IC50 multiples.

gates.go: Blinded IDs, fixed panel, randomization, primary endpoints/contrasts, independent biological units, sample size/precision, exclusions, uncertainty/equivalence and stopping rules timestamped locally before validation.
gates.no_go: Outcomes have been used to tune selection, scores or decision criteria; label exploratory and design a new validation.
gates.not_falsification: A protocol change requires a new labeled test, not retrospective relabeling as confirmatory.
gates.numerical_rule: Size/margins chosen from pilot variance and independently justified smallest meaningful effect; none fabricated here.

gates.go: Prespecified contrasts are resolved at the locked precision and supported by qualified orthogonal chemical/genetic evidence.
gates.no_go: A precise contrary pattern rejects the scoped claim; lack of precision or failed controls yields inconclusive.
gates.not_falsification: Non-significance alone is not evidence of equivalence or no target dependence.
gates.numerical_rule: Apply only the predeclared interpretation rule; never choose a threshold after seeing outcomes.
